2608.19762.title: Finite-Horizon Input-Output Dynamics of Minibatch Perturbations in AdamW
2608.19762.paper_summary: A minibatch can influence training beyond the update at which it is observed because AdamW stores past gradient information in its optimizer states. We study this delayed effect through paired trajectories that differ only in one gradient update and share the same subsequent training sequence. We formulate AdamW as a finite-horizon input--state--output (ISO) system whose state contains the model parameters and first- and second-moment estimates. Linearizing the joint dynamics yields a signed response operator that maps a localized gradient perturbation to its future loss effects, revealing how optimizer memory shapes their magnitude, timing, and sign. We further derive an exact multistep error decomposition and establish first-order finite-horizon accuracy under local smoothness and controlled activation switching. Experiments validate the response mechanism and optimizer-state effects, while repeated-future analyses reveal substantial prospective structure in delayed influence that can be partially recovered from ISO approximations. Code is available at https://github.com/Kanyooo/Loss_ISO.
2608.19762.paper_summary_zh: 一個小批次的影響可以超出其觀察到的更新，因為 AdamW 在其優化器狀態中儲存了過去的梯度信息。我們通過僅在一個梯度更新上有所不同並共享相同後續訓練序列的配對軌跡來研究這種延遲效應。我們將 AdamW 公式化為一個有限視野的輸入-狀態-輸出 (ISO) 系統，其狀態包含模型參數以及一階和二階矩估計。對聯合動力學進行線性化會產生一個有符號的響應運算子，將局部梯度擾動映射到其未來的損失影響，揭示了優化器記憶如何塑造其大小、時機和符號。我們進一步推導出精確的多步誤差分解，並在局部平滑性和受控激活切換下建立一階有限視野準確性。實驗驗證了響應機制和優化器狀態效應，而重複未來分析揭示了延遲影響中顯著的潛在結構，這可以部分從 ISO 近似中恢復。代碼可在 https://github.com/Kanyooo/Loss_ISO 獲得。
